description: CardForm style, default values, and placeholders. iOS applies only the documented cross-platform styles; Android also applies text styles, default values, and placeholders in place.

platformOnly.cardStyle.textColor: CardForm documents every style except backgroundColor, cursorColor, borderColor, and borderRadius as Android only.
platformOnly.cardStyle.fontSize: CardForm documents every style except backgroundColor, cursorColor, borderColor, and borderRadius as Android only.
platformOnly.defaultValues.countryCode: CardForm.defaultValues is documented as Android only.
platformOnly.placeholders.number: CardForm.placeholders is documented as Android only.
platformOnly.placeholders.expiration: CardForm.placeholders is documented as Android only.
platformOnly.placeholders.postalCode: CardForm.placeholders is documented as Android only.
